_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#8, and a falsification of its Signal. The physics is right — bond-based PD fixes nu — but 4C enforces it by not offering the knob, not by silently overriding one, so the quoted observation ('runs but the contraction matches 0.25 regardless of the input nu') cannot be made. MAT_ParticlePD takes exactly INITRADIUS, INITDENSITY, YOUNG, CRITICAL_STRETCH; adding a Poisson ratio under NUE, POISSONRATIO or NU is a hard parse error, 'Could not match this input' from global_data/4C_global_data_read.cpp line 1377, with the MATERIALS block echoed back. All three spellings are rejected and the deck never reaches a time step. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: write the material block back unchanged instead of injecting a Poisson ratio. All three arms then parse and run, the rejection disappears and REJECTED_SPELLINGS becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
